scenes.visual_description: A static, overhead camera angle focuses on a piece of perfectly toasted golden-brown square bread centered on a black circular plate. Two hands wearing black nitrile gloves enter the frame; the right hand holds a small glass jar filled with translucent, iridescent gelatinous cubes in shades of blue, purple, and green. The person pours the cubes onto the center of the toast. The background is a flat, solid white, creating high contrast. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the glassy texture of the cubes and the porous surface of the bread.
scenes.audio_description: Distinct, crunchy sound of toast hitting a plate followed by the wet, squelching sounds of gelatinous cubes tumbling and landing on the bread surface.

scenes.visual_description: From the same static overhead perspective, a right hand in a black glove holds a metal butter knife and begins to press down on the iridescent cubes. As the knife spreads them across the toast, the cubes flatten and melt into a smooth, shimmering, multi-colored jelly. The movement is slow and deliberate. The lighting reflects off the metallic surface of the knife and the glossy, liquid-like texture of the spreading substance. The bread remains stationary on the black plate against the white background.
scenes.audio_description: A rhythmic, squelching sound of the jelly being crushed and spread, accompanied by the faint scraping sound of the metal knife against the toasted surface of the bread.
